summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement on August 6, 2026, issuing a $250,000 convertible note and a warrant for 2,052,545 shares at CAD$0.17 per share to an institutional investor. The note converts at a 10% discount to the lowest VWAP over 20 days, subject to a floor of $0.02436, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. Net proceeds of $225,000 fund general corporate purposes. The company must file a resale registration statement within 30 trading days. This financing structure is dilutive to existing shareholders, making the capital raise the central event.
